pipeline_stages.notes: openwakeword-based 'Hey Jarvis' detector, 1.5s cooldown, background thread, model download on demand. is_installed()/is_ready()/install_and_download() present.
WhisperSTT.transcribe() uses faster-whisper vad_filter=True with min_silence_duration_ms=300. No standalone VAD component; VAD is embedded in Whisper.
WhisperSTT.transcribe() returns full transcript (blocking, not streaming). VoskSTT.process_chunk() supports streaming chunks but is not wired into a microphone loop.
SpectralSpeakerEmbedder (dependency-free fallback) + MultiPersonVoiceProcessor with enroll_speaker/identify_speaker. speechbrain ECAPA-TDNN optional (not installed).
PipelineEngine orchestrates STT → LLM → TTS via provider router. Tool calling via providers/schema.py.
send_realtime_input / send_cli paths exist. Action dispatch via core/action_loader.py TOOL dicts (50+ actions).
TTSPlayer with KokoroTTSEngine (offline neural), EdgeTTSEngine (internet), ElevenLabsTTSEngine (cloud). speak() is blocking; designed for dedicated thread.
TTSPlayer.stop() calls sd.stop() but no VAD-based barge-in / interruption-during-speech logic exists.
No explicit text-input fallback path when microphone is unavailable or user prefers typing.
No single component wires wake→VAD→STT→speaker→LLM→TTS→interruption together end-to-end. Each stage exists independently but is not composed into one pipeline.

stubs_found.note: TTSPlayer.stop() exists but no interruption detection.
WhisperSTT.transcribe() blocks until full utterance; VoskSTT.process_chunk() exists but unwired.

recommended_next_steps: Compose pipeline_orchestrator that chains wake_word → stt_whisper → multi_person_voice → engine_pipeline → tts.
Add interruption detection (VAD during TTS playback) using sd.stop() + wake-word re-arm.
Add text fallback input path for when mic is unavailable.
Confirm pyannote/speechbrain optional path degrades gracefully to SpectralSpeakerEmbedder (already implemented).
verdict: All pipeline stages exist individually; only interruption, text fallback, and end-to-end orchestration are missing. Local dependencies (openwakeword, faster-whisper, piper, sounddevice) are all installed.
